attributes.action: Retain the £1m Business Asset Disposal Relief limit and review rate increases
attributes.additional_details: Many owners spend decades building businesses, creating jobs and planning to fund retirement from a sale. Repeated changes to tax on that sale can undermine their ability to plan. The proposed April 2027 limit cut follows two rate rises. Proposed Founders’ Relief has conditions that can exclude many established smaller businesses. We believe their contribution deserves recognition too - the Government should hear from these owners and provide a fair, stable framework for business succession and retirement.
attributes.background: Retain the £1 million lifetime limit for Business Asset Disposal Relief instead of reducing it to £500,000. Review the rate increases from 10% to 18%, and consult business owners on fair transitional arrangements to protect those who built and planned their businesses under earlier rules.
